metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a std-only Cargo project under [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) with the binary entry at [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). The LAS logic lives in [output/src/las.rs](/workspace/output/src/las.rs), with custom JSON and base64 support in [output/src/json.rs](/workspace/output/src/json.rs) and [output/src/base64.rs](/workspace/output/src/base64.rs). It supports both `inspect` and `render`, validates LAS 1.4 headers/VLRs/EVLRs/CRS/point formats 0-10/waveform metadata/Extra Bytes, recomputes derived header fields on render, and returns the requested response and exit-code shapes without any external dependencies.

Verified with `cargo build --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml` and end-to-end `cargo run --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml -- ...` cases for:
- WKT CRS with point format 6
- GeoTIFF CRS with `geo_key_directory` and `geo_ascii_params`
- Internal waveform data with point format 4, waveform descriptor VLR, and waveform-data EVLR
